styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for main and spec shots, warm mist off-white #F7F2EC for info and closing shots, soft lavender-gray #E9E7F2 for the variant flat lay
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; lifestyle shots use warm 5000K window light from the left
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm-white board #F5F1EA and soft knitted fabric folds as the resting surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short headline and label text only in #3A3A3A, no dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: soft solid-color circle callouts and thin-line icons, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: the two-piece set always shown as a matched top and pants; stable overhead flat lay or slight 3/4 view; polka-dot print scale and contrast kept consistent across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm cozy kids loungewear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm mist off-white #F7F2EC, deep plum #4B2E52 and one mustard-yellow accent #F0B429; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows, warm 5000K window light for lifestyle shots; modern geometric sans-serif with short headline and label text only; consistent soft solid-color circle callouts and thin-line icons; clean kids-wear product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the two-piece set always shown as a matched top and pants with stable polka-dot print scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 11 张爆款儿童舒绒波点家居服长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌 logo、模特身份与面部、原文案、吊牌/领标摄影与密集说明文字；面料成分与检测类声明不落图，由 {callout} 短标与可验证的面料、走线微距承载；原面板 02 与 05 的近似平铺合并为一个 VARIANT 镜头。
